name: officeagent
description: Inspect and edit the Word, PowerPoint and Excel files in your project: Claude previews every change before it is saved, and Word edits arrive as tracked changes you accept or reject in Word.

allow_creation.title: Allow creating new documents
allow_creation.description: Let Claude create new .docx, .pptx and .xlsx files in the project folder, not only edit existing ones.

calculate_formulas.title: Calculate formulas in workbooks
calculate_formulas.description: Save the results of formulas Claude writes in Excel workbooks, for the functions OfficeAgent can calculate. Excel recalculates everything when it opens the file either way.
